answer_1.quote: We investigate three applications: basic language modeling, domain adaptation, and generating citations for question answering.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text continuations, domain-adapted responses, and answers with inline citations.

answer_2.quote: Metrics We use four automatic evaluation metrics to measure the quality of the generated texts: (i) MAUVE ... (ii) Rep-n ... (iii) Diversity ... and (iv) Perplexity ...

answer_3.quote: We also employ GPT-4 (Achiam et al., 2023) for further assessment. ... GPT-4 is asked to evaluate the generated texts by considering fluency, coherence, informativeness, and grammar.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation To gain further assessment, we also run human evaluation on a random sample of 100 generations. ... Annotators are asked to choose which one is better (in terms of fluency, coherence, informativeness, and grammar).
answer_4.guideline: choose which one is better in terms of fluency, coherence, informativeness, and grammar
